blockers.summary: No accessible real Windows ARM64 machine currently exists for S6 parity.
blockers.evidence: The configured Azure VM is no longer discoverable in accessible subscriptions. QEMU TCG proved only the S4 functional launch gate.
blockers.next_step: Use a GitHub-hosted windows-11-arm runner or initialize a new real ARM64 VM before S6.

decisions.decision: Build JPEGView and every shipped private DLL as classic ARM64.
decisions.rationale: The complete in-process dependency graph is source-rebuildable for ARM64; no ARM64EC bridge or ARM64X mixed-host view is required.

arch_surface.arm64Impact: ARM64 enters x86 CPUID and XGETBV code because _WIN64 is used as an x64 test.
ARM64 attempts to compile SSE2 intrinsics and x86-only headers.
AVX2 implementation uses 256-bit x86 intrinsics with no direct NEON equivalent.
AVX translation unit is not excluded from a future ARM64 platform.

arch_surface.evidence: src/JPEGView.sln and native vcxproj platform tables
arch_surface.arm64Impact: No ARM64 solution mapping, target machine, or output layout exists.
Pointer and manifest architecture handling is not explicit for ARM64.
Cross-thread volatile flags are not synchronization and may fail under weak ordering.
Dispatch has no ARM64/NEON identity, but an existing generic correctness path is available.
Dependency acquisition and packages are hardcoded to x86/x64 paths.
Packed persistent records require runtime unaligned-access verification.

next_actions: Replace or correctly route around the temporary ARM64 image-filter stubs.
Replace cross-thread volatile communication with explicit synchronization.
Improve ARM64 CPU feature and physical-core detection without regressing x86/x64.
Run format and GUI correctness checks before removing any TODO(arm64) marker.
Provision real ARM64 authority for S6 parity and no-emulation evidence.

history.event: Built the clean pinned source for x64, verified all 12 shipped PE files as 0x8664, and launched a responsive JPEGView window.
Completed the architecture inventory: x86 CPU probing, SSE2/AVX2 paths, weak-memory risks, and x86/x64-only build/package surfaces are classified.

Classified the full native payload graph with zero unknown or x64-only blockers. All codec modules are source-rebuildable for ARM64; local ARM64 ATL installation remains an S4 environment prerequisite.
Selected classic ARM64 for JPEGView.exe and all eleven shipped private runtime DLLs; ARM64EC and ARM64X were rejected.

Rebuilt the complete dependency graph and product through committed scripts, verified all 12 ARM64 PEs as 0xAA64 with a matched 12-file x64 refusal control, and reached JPEGView's file-open window in Windows ARM64 WinPE under QEMU TCG.
